articles.title: Hut 8's Texas power site sits inside Anthropic’s $35 billion AI deal
articles.snippet: The company's Texas campus has two long-term leases worth $19.6 billion, more than 260 times its latest quarterly revenue, as AI companies race to secure power and data-center capacity.

articles.title: Singapore proposes 100% reserves and a ban on yields for stablecoin issuers
articles.snippet: The country’s financial watchdog says its proposed stablecoin rules are aligned with U.S. and EU frameworks and that it also paves the way for the recognition of foreign stablecoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $78,000 as Arbitrum surges 30% on Robinhood Chain revenue
articles.snippet: BTC drifted lower after last week's rally to $81,428, while ARB led DeFi gains as Robinhood Chain's daily fees topped $2 million.

articles.title: London Stock Exchange to work with Payward to bring biggest UK stocks onchain
articles.snippet: The LSE is working with Kraken owner Payward, the developer of the xStocks tokenized equities framework, to bring top U.K.-listed stocks onchain.

articles.title: OpenAI’s ‘Trust Us’ TIME cover raises an old warning for AI bulls
articles.snippet: The magazine-cover indicator has a messy record, but TIME’s OpenAI cover checks the classic boxes: a mainstream publication, a widely understood theme and a multiyear run-up in investor enthusiasm.
